scenarios.description: A dedicated server of the lane's loader starts with the production jar, applies every mixin and writes the per-world config.

scenarios.title: Three players on a dedicated server

capture.title: Alice meets the dungeon spawner
capture.expectation: Alice sees the untouched spawner active: the mod's golden spawner, with its mob spinning inside.

capture.title: Alice disabled it for herself
capture.expectation: After Alice's hit the spawner is disabled for her: the vanilla spawner with no mob inside, and the chat says it was disabled for one nearby player.

capture.title: Still disabled for Alice after a restart
capture.expectation: After the server restarts and Alice joins again, the spawner she disabled is still the vanilla one for her.

capture.title: Carol's spawner stays active for Alice
capture.expectation: The spawner only Carol disabled is still the golden, active spawner for Alice after the rejoin.

capture.title: A torch next to a spawner goes out
capture.expectation: The torch Alice placed two blocks from a spawner has been put out: an unlit torch stands where she placed it.

capture.title: Bob meets the dungeon spawner
capture.expectation: Bob sees the untouched spawner active from the other side: the golden spawner with its mob inside.

capture.title: Alice's hit disabled it for Bob too
capture.expectation: Bob stood within the group radius when Alice hit the spawner, so it is disabled for him as well: the vanilla spawner, and the chat says Alice disabled a spawner in this area.

capture.title: The chat link that breaks it
capture.expectation: Bob's open chat shows the message that the spawner is disabled for him with the red [Click here to break it] link, which he then clicks to remove the spawner.

capture.title: Carol meets her own spawner
capture.expectation: Carol, far from the others, sees her own untouched spawner active: the golden spawner with its mob inside.

capture.title: Still active for Carol
capture.expectation: The spawner Alice and Bob disabled is still active for Carol, who was out of the group radius: the golden spawner with its mob inside, while Alice and Bob stand beside it.

capture.title: Carol disabled it too
capture.expectation: After Carol hits the spawner the others disabled, it is disabled for her as well: the vanilla spawner with no mob inside.

capture.title: Carol's spawner after a restart
capture.expectation: After the restart and rejoin, the spawner Carol disabled on her own is still the vanilla spawner for her.

capture.title: Carol's spawner respawned
capture.expectation: With a respawn time of one minute set, the spawner Carol disabled is active for her again without rejoining: the golden spawner with its mob inside.
